#| context: setup

# Install and load required packages
webr::install("leaflet")
webr::install("dplyr")
webr::install("sf")
webr::install("shiny")
webr::install("viridis")
webr::install("RColorBrewer")

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Simulate your data structure based on your variables
# In a real implementation, you'd load your actual data files here

# Create sample closure data
set.seed(42)
zip_codes <- c(
  "60601",
  "60602",
  "60603",
  "60604",
  "60605",
  "60606",
  "60607",
  "60608",
  "60609",
  "60610",
  "60611",
  "60612",
  "60613",
  "60614",
  "60615",
  "60616",
  "60617",
  "60618",
  "60619",
  "60620",
  "60621",
  "60622",
  "60623",
  "60624",
  "60625",
  "60626",
  "60627",
  "60628",
  "60629",
  "60630"
)

races <- c("Black", "White", "Hispanic or Latino", "Asian", "Other")
genders <- c("Male", "Female")
risk_levels <- c("LOW", "MODERATE", "HIGH")
results <- c("Successful", "Unsuccessful")

# Generate sample data
n_records <- 1000
closure_by_success <- data.frame(
  zip = sample(zip_codes, n_records, replace = TRUE),
  risk_level = sample(risk_levels, n_records, replace = TRUE),
  sub_result = sample(results, n_records, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4)),
  race = sample(races, n_records, replace = TRUE),
  gender = sample(genders, n_records, replace = TRUE),
  count = sample(1:5, n_records, replace = TRUE)
) |>
  group_by(zip, risk_level, sub_result, race, gender) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

# Create sample Chicago zip code polygons (simplified rectangles for demo)
chicago_bounds <- list(
  lat_min = 41.644,
  lat_max = 42.023,
  lng_min = -87.940,
  lng_max = -87.524
)

# Generate sample polygon coordinates for each zip code
chicago_zip <- data.frame(
  zip = zip_codes,
  lat = runif(
    length(zip_codes),
    chicago_bounds$lat_min,
    chicago_bounds$lat_max
  ),
  lng = runif(length(zip_codes), chicago_bounds$lng_min, chicago_bounds$lng_max)
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    # Create simple rectangular polygons for each zip
    geometry = list(list(
      c(lng - 0.01, lat - 0.01),
      c(lng + 0.01, lat - 0.01),
      c(lng + 0.01, lat + 0.01),
      c(lng - 0.01, lat + 0.01),
      c(lng - 0.01, lat - 0.01)
    ))
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# Function to calculate success rates by demographics
calculate_success_rates <- function(data, demo_filter = "All") {
  if (demo_filter == "All") {
    filtered_data <- data
  } else if (demo_filter %in% races) {
    filtered_data <- data |> filter(race == demo_filter)
  } else if (demo_filter %in% genders) {
    filtered_data <- data |> filter(gender == demo_filter)
  } else {
    filtered_data <- data
  }

  result <- filtered_data |>
    group_by(zip) |>
    summarise(
      total_cases = sum(count),
      successful_cases = sum(count[sub_result == "Successful"]),
      success_rate = successful_cases / total_cases,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(total_cases > 0) # Only include zips with cases

  return(result)
}

# Color palette for success rates (colorblind-safe)
success_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "RdYlGn",
  domain = c(0, 1),
  reverse = FALSE
)

# Color palette for risk visualization
risk_colors <- c("LOW" = "#2ecc71", "MODERATE" = "#f39c12", "HIGH" = "#e74c3c")

```{webr-r}
#| context: server

# Define UI
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Chicago Probation Success Rates by Zip Code"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      h4("Filter Options"),

      radioButtons(
        "demo_filter",
        "Demographic Filter:",
        choices = list(
          "All Cases" = "All",
          "--- By Race ---" = "",
          "Black" = "Black",
          "White" = "White",
          "Hispanic or Latino" = "Hispanic or Latino",
          "Asian" = "Asian",
          "Other Race" = "Other",
          "--- By Gender ---" = "",
          "Male" = "Male",
          "Female" = "Female"
        ),
        selected = "All"
      ),

      br(),

      h4("Map Information"),
      p("Colors represent success rates:"),
      tags$ul(
        tags$li(
          tags$span("Red:", style = "color: #d73027; font-weight: bold;"),
          " Low success rates"
        ),
        tags$li(
          tags$span("Yellow:", style = "color: #fee08b; font-weight: bold;"),
          " Moderate success rates"
        ),
        tags$li(
          tags$span("Green:", style = "color: #1a9850; font-weight: bold;"),
          " High success rates"
        )
      ),

      br(),

      verbatimTextOutput("summary_stats")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      leafletOutput("map", height = "600px"),
      br(),
      h4("Data Summary"),
      tableOutput("data_table")
    )
  )
)

# Define Server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Reactive data based on demographic filter
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$demo_filter)

    # Skip separator items
    if (input$demo_filter == "") {
      return(calculate_success_rates(closure_by_success, "All"))
    }

    calculate_success_rates(closure_by_success, input$demo_filter)
  })

  # Create the map
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    data <- filtered_data()

    # Create map data by joining with zip boundaries
    map_data <- chicago_zip |>
      left_join(data, by = "zip") |>
      mutate(
        success_rate = ifelse(is.na(success_rate), 0, success_rate),
        total_cases = ifelse(is.na(total_cases), 0, total_cases),
        popup_text = paste0(
          "<b>Zip Code:</b> ",
          zip,
          "<br>",
          "<b>Total Cases:</b> ",
          total_cases,
          "<br>",
          "<b>Success Rate:</b> ",
          round(success_rate * 100, 1),
          "%"
        )
      )

    # Create polygons for leaflet
    polygons <- map_data |>
      rowwise() |>
      do({
        coords <- .$geometry[[1]]
        lat_coords <- sapply(coords, function(x) x[2])
        lng_coords <- sapply(coords, function(x) x[1])

        data.frame(
          zip = .$zip,
          lat = I(list(lat_coords)),
          lng = I(list(lng_coords)),
          success_rate = .$success_rate,
          total_cases = .$total_cases,
          popup_text = .$popup_text
        )
      })

    # Create the leaflet map
    m <- leaflet() |>
      addTiles() |>
      setView(lng = -87.7, lat = 41.85, zoom = 11)

    # Add polygons
    for (i in 1:nrow(polygons)) {
      if (polygons$total_cases[i] > 0) {
        m <- m |>
          addPolygons(
            lat = polygons$lat[[i]],
            lng = polygons$lng[[i]],
            fillColor = success_pal(polygons$success_rate[i]),
            fillOpacity = 0.7,
            color = "black",
            weight = 2,
            popup = polygons$popup_text[i],
            label = paste("Zip:", polygons$zip[i])
          )
      }
    }

    # Add legend
    m <- m |>
      addLegend(
        pal = success_pal,
        values = c(0, 1),
        opacity = 0.7,
        title = "Success Rate",
        position = "bottomright",
        labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = function(x) x * 100)
      )

    return(m)
  })

  # Summary statistics
  output$summary_stats <- renderText({
    data <- filtered_data()

    if (nrow(data) == 0) {
      return("No data available for selected filter.")
    }

    total_cases <- sum(data$total_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
    avg_success_rate <- weighted.mean(
      data$success_rate,
      data$total_cases,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    zip_count <- nrow(data)

    paste0(
      "Filter: ",
      input$demo_filter,
      "\n",
      "Zip Codes: ",
      zip_count,
      "\n",
      "Total Cases: ",
      total_cases,
      "\n",
      "Avg Success Rate: ",
      round(avg_success_rate * 100, 1),
      "%"
    )
  })

  # Data table
  output$data_table <- renderTable(
    {
      data <- filtered_data() |>
        arrange(desc(success_rate)) |>
        mutate(
          success_rate = paste0(round(success_rate * 100, 1), "%")
        ) |>
        select(
          `Zip Code` = zip,
          `Total Cases` = total_cases,
          `Success Rate` = success_rate
        ) |>
        head(10)

      return(data)
    },
    striped = TRUE,
    hover = TRUE
  )
}

# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
